domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n > 1
t is any real number (no additional restriction stated)
k ranges over integers satisfying 1 <= k <= n
floor(x) denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to x
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n with n > 1 and for all real numbers t, if for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n the floor of (k times t) equals k minus 1, then E_n(t) equals H_n minus 1.
quantifier_order: for all n such that n is an integer and n > 1
for all t such that t is a real number
if for all k such that k is an integer and 1 <= k <= n, floor(k times t) equals k minus 1

variables.name: n
variables.role: outer parameter indexing the quantities E_n and H_n, and setting the range for k

variables.name: t
variables.role: input to E_n(t), and multiplier inside floor(k*t)

variables.name: k
variables.role: index in the antecedent universal condition on floor(k*t)

witness_dependencies: none: the condition requires a universal statement over all k in the given range; there is no existential witness

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t, if floor(k*t) = k-1 for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n, then E_n(t) = H_n - 1.
